tool_input.command:
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token = [string](($login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$listUri = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?search=blur&dataId=&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&pageNo=1&pageSize=100&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $listUri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
'CONFIG_LIST_HTTP=' + [int]$response.StatusCode
if ([int]$response.StatusCode -eq 200) {
  $data = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
  'TOTAL=' + $data.totalCount
  $items = @($data.pageItems | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.dataId })
  'DATA_IDS=' + (($items | Where-Object { $_ -match '(?i)druid|datasource|database|application' }) -join ',')
}
